acceptance.record_on_runs_and_non_runs: web: SourceRecord.filter Run{reasons}/Skip{excluded_by} with status 'filtered' and no run (engine test); hosted: execution trigger_gate stores 'skipped' attempt with excluded list and adds trigger{index,event,reasons} to run results

trade_offs: Hosted source events and changed files describe the customer workspace; they decide hosted plan execution, not review CI.
Web registrations keep one exact head reference; branches widen pull-request bases and restrict pushes.
Sibling selection still takes the first registration per project; its filter decides that project's record.
Matched reasons are recorded on the automation source record linked by run_id, not duplicated into RunRecord, to avoid changing the shared enqueue path.
not_run: hosted execution trigger_gate dedicated unit test (covered by compile + select tests; run_pipeline needs operator execution config)
